S1 casts L2 Burning Hands from(60,60,10), cone encompassing V(46,61,5) and unconscious F(46,65,10), both within15ft and cone width; V Dex d20=3+8=11/DC12 fails, F automatically fails Dex due unconsciousness, shared 4d6=1,1,6,2 total10 fire. V10→0/48 unconscious prone, no instant death, F remains0/59 and takes one death save failure (1→2 failures), no instant death. S1 L2 2→1/3; then moves to(65,70,10) along rough shelf, cost22.36ft. Actual batchcd2fde732c6a0665c5da2b814c6cc55e. Mara continues controlled backing to coach(0,-70), intact four horses. No V reaction triggered or resource expenditure.

R7 C13 recognizes F is at two failed death saves, uses final L2 Healing Word BA on F within60ft, actual2d4=4,1+5=10, F0→10/59 conscious prone and both failures clear. C L2 1→0/3. Action Dash to V's side, from(15,50,0) to(42,59,5) across rough slope, conservative cost~57.8ft of60, within4.47ft of V. F11 stands (20ft), moves to(46,63,7) on lower ledge within5ft of V, cost~7.22ft, independently prioritizes V's survival over pursuit; action Medicine d20=13+2=15/DC10 success, V stabilized at0HP, death saves reset, no V death save on own R7 turn. F10/59 upright, no additional Rage/Shift/MP. C HP51/51 unchanged. Actual batch7cb1bffdd40e915abf87695e1512c856.

R8 S1 and S2 continue their coordinated withdrawal instead of remaining exposed after loss of five members. S2 already invisible moves to fissure threshold and inward within movement allowance, S1 casts L2 Invisibility (1→0/3, concentration) and moves to threshold from(65,70,10) along shaded shelf (22.36ft movement), follows toward fissure. Both are now unseen, no confirmed safe escape, no exact unverified interior geometry or extra forces asserted; possible pursuit requires actual reconnaissance. No further enemy attack or damage. Mara continues cautious backing to coach(0,-80), healthy four horses intact. C13 at(42,59,5) casts L1 Healing Word BA on stable V within5ft, actual d4=1+5=6 HP, V0→6/48 conscious prone, no death failures, C L1 4→3/4 and L2/L3 0. C action Dodge, no movement, reaction available. F11 guards V/C at(46,63,7) with Ready one Double-Claw Rend if a visible hostile enters5ft and attacks party, reaction available, no roll or resource spend. Actual batch28293536e1cdd62459f389b7f28a8c80. R8 V6 now fresh turn, conscious prone. No V decision beyond 'Continue' assumed, no further healing, chase, retreat, loot or conclusion. Encounter not closed; pause for V choice.
